page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual server configuration within the ecs.gn5 instance family. Powered by the KVM hypervisor on x86_64 architecture, this instance features 56 dedicated vCPUs and 224.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 4.0 GB RAM allocation per core. Acceleration is provided by two NVIDIA P100 GPUs offering a combined total of 32 GB VRAM.

Storage hardware includes 944 GB of local SSD capacity directly attached to the instance. The network interface supports a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. This instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring secondary allocation or networking structures for public internet routing.

With its dual NVIDIA P100 graphics processing units and high core count, the server offers hardware-accelerated compute capacity for legacy GPU frameworks. The fixed memory ratio and local SSD storage provide balanced resources for enterprise processing tasks. Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.14xlarge is suitable for deep learning training, AI inference execution, scientific simulations, high-performance graphics rendering, and batch data processing workloads.
